propositions: An alternates-backed shared clone can report near-zero pack.logical_bytes because the primary pack layer measures only objects/pack/*.pack and not the borrowed alternate object database, misleading readers into mistaking a partial measurement for a complete object store

The pack_layer schema and rendering must surface a complete boolean field that is false when alternates are present (non-exclusive measurement) and true for standalone or linked-worktree clones (complete primary-only measurement)
Filesystem allocation assertions currently assume a fixed block-size ratio that fails on block-suballocating filesystems; they must use injected or stat-based st_blocks measurement instead
Text rendering for allocation-unavailable state and CLI bad-argument exit-2 path lack direct unit test coverage
Linked-worktree pack measurement must remain complete:true because the common pack is measured and is the complete backing store for the worktree, even though shared across worktrees
